name: The Echo Prophecy

start.dialog: Twin One: We heard the prophecy! / Twin Two: Eight foundations! Eight bearers! / Twin One: But one is hidden! / Twin Two: Find the hidden foundation! / Both: In the Prism of Fate!
start.objective: Investigate the Prism caves for signs of a hidden ninth foundation

progress.dialog: Twin One: The crystals whisper... / Twin Two: Of something beyond the eight! / Twin One: Look where light bends! / Twin Two: Where shadow becomes light!
progress.objective: Find the location where light and shadow converge

complete.dialog: Twin One: You found it! / Twin Two: The ninth resonance! / Twin One: Not a foundation... but a binding! / Twin Two: The thread that holds all! / Both: Take this! Proof of your discovery!

party_comments.kade: A ninth foundation? That changes... everything.
party_comments.sova: Impossible. The texts clearly state eight. And yet...
party_comments.nix7: Data suggests additional energy signature. Analysis: ongoing.

hidden_outcome: If you return with the crystal to the Sanctuary Keeper, it unlocks the true ending path and reveals the 'Prime Vector' theory
